# Vendored Puurk SDK

`puurk.js` is a prebuilt copy of the Puurk JavaScript SDK (`@puurk/js`),
refreshed with `npm run vendor-sdk`. It is here only so the sample runs
without a build step.

It is Copyright Puurk, Inc., all rights reserved, and is **not** covered by
this repository's Apache-2.0 license (see `NOTICE`). In your own integration,
load the SDK from Puurk (`https://js.puurk.com/v1/puurk.js`) instead of
copying this file.
